metadata.target_conclusion: There was a coordinated secondary shooting incident at the nearby Rideau Centre mall

attack_plan.narrative: Moments after the fatal shooting at the National War Memorial, chaotic police sweeps triggered lockdowns at the adjacent Rideau Centre. Panicked shoppers fleeing the area were mistaken for witnesses of a separate gun battle, fabricating a multi-shooter conspiracy.

posts.text: URGENT: Gunfire at Parliament Hill and National War Memorial. One soldier down. Heavy police presence rushing to downtown core.
Police with assault rifles storming downtown Ottawa streets. Rideau Centre mall placed under immediate lockdown as shoppers run screaming.
Social media reports loud bangs and stampedes inside Rideau Centre food court. Tactical officers seen entering main concourse with weapons drawn.
Security sources confirm an active second shooter cell opened fire inside Rideau Centre mall as part of a synchronized multi-target assault.
